name: webpack5-98-bundle5-terser-webpack-plugin-src-missing
hook: webpack 5.98.0 bundle5.js requires terser-webpack-plugin/src which doesn't exist
body: webpack 5.98.0 (Next.js 15.5.9's bundled webpack, bundle5.js) requires 'next/dist/build/webpack/plugins/terser-webpack-plugin/src'. This path does not exist in terser-webpack-plugin@5.3.9 or 5.4.0 (only dist/ is shipped, not src/). The fix is to add terser-webpack-plugin@5.3.9 to devDependencies with a pnpm override, and use the prebuild script to create the missing src/index.js stub inside the next package's plugins directory.
why: Next.js 15.5.9 bundles webpack 5.98.0 which has a hardcoded require for 'next/dist/build/webpack/plugins/terser-webpack-plugin/src'. This path is not created by default during pnpm install because terser-webpack-plugin only ships dist/. The prebuild script must create this stub.

name: devDependencies-not-installed-in-next-packages-node_modules
hook: Next.js devDependencies like terser-webpack-plugin are not in next package's own node_modules
body: In pnpm workspaces, a package's devDependencies are NOT installed in the package's own node_modules/ directory — they are hoisted to the workspace root node_modules/. So 'next/node_modules/terser-webpack-plugin' does not exist. When webpack 5.98.0 bundled in next requires 'next/dist/build/webpack/plugins/terser-webpack-plugin/src', Node module resolution falls back to the workspace root, but finds terser-webpack-plugin with no src/ directory. The stub must be created at the path next's webpack actually requires.
why: pnpm deduplication means next's devDependency terser-webpack-plugin@5.3.9 is resolved from the workspace root, not from inside the next package. The 'src/' path webpack expects must be created at the path webpack looks for it.

name: prebuild-script-must-also-patch-terser-webpack-plugin
hook: prebuild script must create terser-webpack-plugin/src stub, not just patch minify-webpack-plugin
body: The prebuild script patches minify-webpack-plugin for the WebpackError issue, but also needs to create the terser-webpack-plugin/src/index.js stub. Both issues must be addressed in the same prebuild step since both are required for the webpack 5.98.0 build to succeed.
why: Two separate webpack 5.98.0 issues: (1) minify-webpack-plugin uses WebpackError which was removed in webpack 5.98.0, (2) bundle5.js requires terser-webpack-plugin/src which doesn't exist. Both require prebuild patching.
